exercises.title: Slide check: components, props and state
exercises.problemHtml:
Ten questions on Slot 6: what components are, props vs state, class vs function components and their lifecycle.

Tip: read every option before choosing — the wrong options are real mistakes students make in the FE exam.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All questions must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

Mẹo: đọc hết các lựa chọn rồi mới chọn — các phương án sai đều là lỗi thật sinh viên hay mắc trong đề FE.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Slide check: components, props and state — answer key

1. A React component name must…
   Answer: b) start with a capital letter
   Lower-case JSX tags are treated as HTML elements. / Thẻ JSX viết thường bị coi là thẻ HTML.

2. Inside a child component, props are…
   Answer: a) read-only
   A component must never modify its own props — ask the parent through a callback. / Component không được sửa props của chính nó — nhờ cha qua callback.

3. Which is TRUE about state?
   Answer: b) Changing it with its setter re-renders the component.
   State is local to each instance; setting it schedules a re-render. / State riêng cho từng instance; gọi hàm đặt sẽ lên lịch vẽ lại.

4. In a class component, state is updated with…
   Answer: b) this.setState({ x: 1 })
   this.setState merges the change and re-renders. / this.setState trộn thay đổi và vẽ lại.

5. Which class method runs once after the component appears on screen?
   Answer: b) componentDidMount
   componentDidMount ≈ useEffect(fn, []) in function components. / componentDidMount ≈ useEffect(fn, []) ở function component.

6. Which are advantages of function components with hooks? (choose all)
   Answer: a) Less boilerplate (no this, no binding) + b) Logic can be reused with custom hooks + d) Recommended style for new React code
   Class components still have state; hooks are just simpler and reusable. / Class vẫn có state; hooks chỉ gọn và dễ tái sử dụng hơn.

7. props.children contains…
   Answer: b) whatever is written between the opening and closing tags
   Anything nested inside <Comp>…</Comp>: text, elements, components. / Mọi thứ lồng trong …: chữ, phần tử, component.

8. Lifting state up means…
   Answer: a) moving state to the closest common parent of the components that need it
   The common parent owns the data and passes it down with callbacks to change it. / Cha chung giữ dữ liệu, truyền xuống kèm callback để thay đổi.

9. After const [n, setN] = useState(0), which correctly increments?
   Answer: b) setN(n + 1) or setN((c) => c + 1)
   Always go through the setter; the updater form is safest when chaining. / Luôn qua hàm đặt; dạng hàm cập nhật an toàn nhất khi gọi liên tiếp.

10. A pure component (in the React sense)…
   Answer: a) renders the same output for the same props and state
   Rendering must not have side effects — same inputs, same JSX. / Render không được có tác dụng phụ — cùng đầu vào, cùng JSX.
